rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you box that photo, tell me that year mattered.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's only a picture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then say what isn't in the paper.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We were happy there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Now we can pack the picture without packing that away.

card.title: Acknowledge Our History
card.instruction: Make someone recognize that the relationship, memory, or sacrifice mattered and cannot be treated as incidental.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't call our trip a random weekend. We saved for months.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I remember.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Name one thing before you throw out the ticket.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We missed the boat and stayed anyway.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. That's why this isn't just cardboard.

card.title: Acknowledge Our History
card.instruction: Make someone recognize that the relationship, memory, or sacrifice mattered and cannot be treated as incidental.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave the work call ringing. Stay with this conversation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's important.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then choosing us would mean something.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll call back in ten minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Give these ten minutes to me without watching the phone.

card.title: Choose the Relationship
card.instruction: Make someone prioritize this connection over a competing person, promise, or opportunity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Skip the networking dinner. Have one ordinary evening here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: This opportunity won't come again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Neither will tonight exactly like this.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Couldn't we eat tomorrow?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We could. I'm asking whether we ever come first today.

card.title: Choose the Relationship
card.instruction: Make someone prioritize this connection over a competing person, promise, or opportunity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which cup would you pour my tea into?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Either?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One of them has been mine for twelve years.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The blue one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And how much milk? Let's see how the memory travels.

card.title: Remember Me Correctly
card.instruction: Create small tests of whether someone remembers your preferences, stories, or shared history.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Remember our first holiday? Finish the story about the boat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We missed it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And what did I say at the dock?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't remember.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You used to tell that bit before I reached it.

card.title: Remember Me Correctly
card.instruction: Create small tests of whether someone remembers your preferences, stories, or shared history.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bring the memory of our argument to dinner, but leave the demand for payment.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not ready to forget.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm not asking you to forget. I'm asking for one meal without interest.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What if it comes up?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let it visit. Don't give it my chair.

card.title: Let Go of the Grudge
card.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender resentment, distance, or a claim that keeps the relationship stuck.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you stop using the missed birthday as the answer to everything?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It still hurt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep telling me that. Stop making it the reason I can't help now.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You want a clean slate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. Just enough space on it for today's date.

card.title: Let Go of the Grudge
card.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender resentment, distance, or a claim that keeps the relationship stuck.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've missed our letters. Here's some fresh stationery.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You stopped answering mine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And now look at all this room to begin.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why did you stop?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's not waste the first page on the gap.

card.title: I Pulled Away First
card.instruction: Hide your role in creating the distance while working urgently to repair it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've made you a new key. Lovely to have you visiting again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why did you change the lock?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The important thing is this one works.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I couldn't get in for months.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll make an especially welcoming first cup of tea.

card.title: I Pulled Away First
card.instruction: Hide your role in creating the distance while working urgently to repair it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Remember the sunshine on our last picnic? Beautiful sandwiches too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's when you stopped speaking to me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Did we use mustard or pickle?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why did you disappear?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll make both. We can at least recover the sandwiches.

card.title: Not Why We Drifted
card.instruction: Keep the conversation away from the real reason the relationship changed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's choose a film like we used to.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we discuss why we stopped meeting?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We never finished that comedy.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You walked out halfway through our argument.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll start the film at halfway. Efficient reunion.

card.title: Not Why We Drifted
card.instruction: Keep the conversation away from the real reason the relationship changed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No new messages worth discussing. Let's enjoy breakfast.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's a letter under your plate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A detail that would spoil the eggs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Has your brother changed the plans again?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The eggs haven't changed. Let's stay with their reliability.

card.title: Keep the Peace
card.instruction: Hide a truth because you believe the relationship cannot survive one more conflict.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've given you the short version so we can have a quiet evening.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What's in the long version?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Several reasons not to have a quiet evening.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can't hide everything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. Just enough to finish this cup of tea.

card.title: Keep the Peace
card.instruction: Hide a truth because you believe the relationship cannot survive one more conflict.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Was the flat very quiet while I was away?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you miss me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm asking about the acoustics here first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I kept expecting your key.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Tell me that bit before I tell you about mine.

card.title: Say You Missed Me
card.instruction: Get someone to admit longing, jealousy, hurt, or attachment before you reveal your own.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Did anyone sit in my chair after I left?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody wanted it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Because it wobbles, or because it was mine?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Because it was yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right. Now I can tell you why I kept the cushion.

card.title: Say You Missed Me
card.instruction: Get someone to admit longing, jealousy, hurt, or attachment before you reveal your own.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That year apart was probably healthy for us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We didn't speak at all.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A thorough reset. No half-measures.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We forgot each other's birthdays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Now remembering them can be a fresh choice.

card.title: We Needed the Break
card.instruction: Frame a rupture, absence, or failed connection as a healthy decision that ultimately helped.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The disastrous reunion showed us what needed changing.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You called it a disaster.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent diagnostic material.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We left separately.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we successfully identified the direction problem.

card.title: We Needed the Break
card.instruction: Frame a rupture, absence, or failed connection as a healthy decision that ultimately helped.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I know how to fix us. First tea, then one honest sentence.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You just invented that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Every established method had a first kettle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What's step three?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll know after the sentence. It's a responsive method.

card.title: I Know How to Fix Us
card.instruction: Perform confidence about repairing the relationship while improvising every step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're on stage two of reconciliation. Choose a biscuit.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What was stage one?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Getting you to ask about the process.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You haven't got a process.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good honesty. Stage two is already working.

card.title: I Know How to Fix Us
card.instruction: Perform confidence about repairing the relationship while improvising every step.
